paragraphs: Avin bar Binyamin and Rabbi Acha, in Rabbi Abba’s name; Midrash Rabbah, Tzav, section 10. The same subject in Rabbah, Chazit, on “Set me as a seal”: Rav Acha son of Rabbi Avin bar Binyamin—a scribal error. In Rabbi Acha, son of Rav Pappi’s name.
